[[File:Whistler_Cresh.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Valin Horn]] playing with [[Whistler]] in the key of Cresh.]]
The '''key of {{AurB|C}}''' (pronounced "[[Cresh/Legends|cresh]]") was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] key named after the third letter in the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] alphabet, {{Aur|C}}.

==Behind the scenes==
The key of Cresh is the equivalent of the [[Wikipedia:C major|key of C]].
